scope: Ten real schema2 stores; each side receives an independent copy. One first process includes schema migration on the candidate. Then five alternating fresh processes per side/case. Time validated connection, head/view/revisions, source byte verification and output hashing; outer process time includes imports and exit. Peak RSS is process-lifetime OS high-water mark, not retained heap. OS caches uncontrolled. Primary success: >=50% smaller database in every case, exact public outputs and all logical SQL rows, unchanged originals and other files. Secondary latency/RSS claims require separated observed ranges in all cases. Separate real MCP check is required; no model or whole-agent speed claim.
